method: official V8 Istanbul coverage-final.json; exact zero-context diff added lines (replacement new side); select each statement/branch/function whose mapped source span intersects changed lines, count every branch arm; line coverage uses official statement start.line max(count). Enclosing legacy spans remain included, not stripped. Changed non-start lines listed separately; all maps retained. main-channel subprocess coverage not collected by this provider: zero means unproven, not an observed failed path.
